tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation decisively refuted the fitted siphon branch (RMSE 2.96 versus tolerance 0.045). The existing rows vary u_now and s_grad together, leaving static inhibition and alternative gradient-dependent mechanisms confounded. A high-s_grad regime probe is the least costly relevant next measurement to separate these effects.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a revised static siphon model (including Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated flux)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations co-vary input and gradient, so the poor fresh-confirmation RMSE indicates the current fit does not identify the mechanism; refitting the same confounded design risks another false confirmation.
The pilot shows no horizon dependence or memory evidence, so an ODE trajectory batch is not the most relevant discriminator.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not address the input/gradient confounding.
